exceptionClasses.TRADING_PATH: An input a trading or Paper book, its shadows or its research needs on the trading clock (same day, intraday), or the pre-open context those books show on the desk. Stays with the trading system.
exceptionClasses.RECONCILIATION_ONLY: Read only to compare against the owner's copy; never displayed as a fact, never an input to a decision or a publication.
exceptionClasses.INTERIM: A temporary second collector with a written expiresOn date; the guard fails after that date.
exceptionClasses.CONSUMER: Cycle Atlas (the owner side) reads a private-side system's TRADING_PATH dataset as read-only aggregates; only in systems.<system>.forbiddenUpstream.exceptions. It cites a registered dataset owned by another system whose consumer entry for this system lists the paths and says READ_ONLY_AGGREGATES; the consumer entry may carry an expiresOn. The private side stays the only collector.
